JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Character Editor
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Character Editor: edit pawns, appearance, gear, health, skills and genes in game or at the start.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Xenotypes you create with it can show up in other factions.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: Mod Settings Overrides keeps your own xenotypes away from other factions.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Pawn Compatibility Editor
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Pawn Compatibility Editor: view and override the compatibility between pawns.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: RocketMan - Performance Mod
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: RocketMan: throttles pawn ticks and caches stats for speed.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Its About.xml lists RimWorld up to 1.5 only.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Performance Optimizer
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Performance Optimizer: optimises vanilla routines, caches UI and throttles background checks.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Dubs Performance Analyzer
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Dubs Performance Analyzer: profiles where tick and frame time goes, per mod.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: The tool to use when a JB mod seems slow; the numbers help a bug report.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Multiplayer
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Multiplayer: co-op over LAN or the internet on one colony.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Every mod must make the same random choices on every machine; JB mods are not tested in Multiplayer.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: JB Framework's random streams are deterministic per save, a good base; still treat JB mods in Multiplayer as untested.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Multiplayer Compatibility
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Multiplayer Compatibility: patches that make other mods work with Multiplayer.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: RimTalk
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: RimTalk: AI-written dialogue for social interactions.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Work Tab
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Work Tab: sub-tasks per work type, priorities by time of day, priorities up to 9.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: RimHUD
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: RimHUD: a configurable HUD instead of the inspect card.
